The '''New Raithal system''' lay in the [[Annecy sector/Legends|Annecy sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The New Raithal [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square P-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
